clauses.quote: Protocols for all related service providers shall be provided by the DCPS Office of Special Education.
clauses.subject_text: Protocols for all related service providers

clauses.quote: the local school Supervisor shall provide funding for supplies to all related service providers assigned to his/her school.
Related service providers shall be provided a room with confidential access to an operational telephone and computer.
Assignment of caseloads to related service providers shall be done in an equitable manner.
clauses.subject_text: Assignment of caseloads to related service providers

clauses.quote: The Office of Special Education will address disputes regarding equity in caseload assignments for service providers on a case-by-case basis.
any unscheduled time shall be used in a relevant manner toward improving the instructional program.
One (1) afternoon per week shall be devoted to record keeping, meetings, planning, and any other relevant activities toward improving the instructional program.
Weekly teaching schedules must be updated promptly.
If no changes occur during the week, such notation shall be recorded.
Teachers assigned full-time to child-oriented hospitals or institutions shall adjust their teaching schedules in consultation with their Supervisor.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers assigned full-time to child-oriented hospitals or institutions

clauses.quote: When a daily schedule is to be rearranged, the Supervisor shall be notified by telephone within a reasonable time
a record of the changes shall be recorded as soon as practicable.
the Teacher may require adult supervision in the home while instruction is taking place.
Daily attendance records noting teachers’ time of arrival with signature of parent or guardian and/or pupil shall be submitted to the Supervisor weekly.
clauses.subject_text: Daily attendance records noting teachers’ time of arrival with signature of parent or guardian and/or pupil

clauses.quote: An orientation of at least 3 days shall be provided for all new teachers in the VIS program.
clauses.subject_text: An orientation of at least 3 days

clauses.quote: A Teacher shall not be required to provide instructional services in any home, institution, or area if there is a valid reason to believe that the physical well being of the Teacher is threatened.
